_note: ZF CV India reports a single Ind AS 108 segment (automotive components) and discloses revenue by business line in its presentations and calls: domestic OEM, aftermarket, exports of goods, and 'service income + other income' (services exported to ZF group centres plus other operating and other income). Totals in the decks are TOTAL INCOME (revenue + other income) and 'EBITA' includes other income. FY25-FY26 services are split from note 18 of the AR (services Rs453.4 / Rs504.1 cr; other operating revenue Rs37.3 / Rs28.0 cr; other income Rs108.2 / Rs183.2 cr). Quarterly values are read from the Q4FY26 deck chart labels and reconciled to the quarterly total income on Screener.in (within Rs8 cr); Q1FY27 aftermarket and exports are from the call, OEM is derived from the stated +8.6% growth and 'services + other income' as the residual.
